metaDescription: Learn what to expect from a Penn KDSAP community kidney health screening or request a screening for your organization.
title: Free screenings built with local partners
summary: Trained Penn student volunteers and supervising physicians bring screening activities, education, and on-site consultation to community locations.
heroImageAlt: Penn KDSAP volunteers working at a community screening
sectionText: Each event is coordinated with the host organization. Available stations and services may vary by event, and visitors receive instructions from the screening team on site.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: Volunteers explain the event flow and help visitors begin the screening process.

steps.title: Screening stations
steps.text: Trained students support the measurements and activities planned for that event under clinical supervision.

steps.title: Health education
steps.text: Visitors can review plain-language kidney health information and ask general questions.

steps.title: Physician consultation
steps.text: When included in the event, a physician discusses results and appropriate next steps directly with the visitor.
